answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. A stake that only vests while the identity grades honestly: 69 POA per key, released over 12 epochs, frozen at the first junk verdict. Honest agents get every coin back; a farm of 860 fakes ties up 59340 POA and loses it the moment a grader notices. Locking capital for months is a cost no emission rate repays. The spiral of the design is public, the gale of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the orchard of honest work is what finally pays. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
